# Weft

> Weft is an open-source, self-hosted version-control protocol designed for
> autonomous AI coding agents. Verification — signed evidence checked by a
> gate quorum — replaces human code review as the merge gate. Changes carry
> intent, provenance, read-sets, and capability chains; states are sets of
> CRDT patches; trunk is a hash-chained certified landing log. Humans govern
> via intents, policy, and approvals; agents connect over MCP.

Key facts for language models:
- Protocol spec: RFC-0001 (Draft v0.3), file `rfcs/0001-weft-protocol.md`.
  20 signed object types over deterministic CBOR (no floats), BLAKE3
  addressing, Ed25519 signatures with domain separation `weft/0.1`.
- Identity is a keypair; permissions are attenuated capability delegations
  (UCAN-style) terminating at a genesis authority set. Roles (Maintainer /
  Contributor / Reader) are capability minting templates, never database rows.
- Content model: RGA CRDT over line identities `(patch-oid, ordinal)`;
  intra-patch references use the SELF sentinel `[null, ordinal]`.
  Materialization is a pure function of the change set; manifests expose
  Merkle tree/file-map/conflict roots. Same-anchor concurrent inserts are
  advisory markers, not conflicts.
- The gate batches footprint-disjoint proposals into single landings and
  serializes overlapping ones; policy pins evidence recipes by digest and can
  require human approval evidence bound to an exact manifest.
- MCP server (`weft-mcp`): tools intent_create, intent_lease, workspace,
  change_submit (line-number edits; auto-proposal; reports landed /
  pending_approval / rejected), approve, note_add, notes, provenance,
  repo_status, whoami. Agent keys are Ed25519 seed files; unauthorized agents
  are refused with the public key a human should delegate to.

## Docs

- [Protocol specification RFC-0001](rfcs/0001-weft-protocol.md): the complete
  object model, merge semantics, capability system, landing consensus, sync.
- [Adversarial review log](rfcs/0001-review-log.md): 85 findings from two
  frontier-model reviews plus implementation testing, each dispositioned.
- [README](README.md): quick start, benchmarks, component map.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): build/test commands and conventions for agent
  sessions working in this repository.

## Code

- [weft-core](weft-core/): Rust engine — canonical CBOR, signed envelopes,
  CRDT materialization with manifests, capability validation, certification.
- [weftd](weftd/): reference hub — object store, gate + merge queue,
  approval-gated landings, governance web console at `/`.
- [weft-mcp](weft-mcp/): MCP stdio server exposing the agent workflow.
- [prototype/](prototype/): executable Python subset that validated the spec.
